title: search_announcements
description: Search recent school announcements. Use this whenever the user asks about announcements, notices, or news from an office.
$comment: Contract between the Ollama model and the Spring app. Breaking changes get a new $id version (v2) instead of editing v1. Descriptions are sent to the model; implementation notes go in $comment.

arguments.$comment: Must stay free of $ref so it can be used directly as the tool's parameters. Spring applies the defaults; the schema only documents them.

query.description: Keywords to search for in announcement titles and text

days.description: How many days back to look, by publication date

limit.description: Maximum number of announcements to return

excerpt.description: The announcement body, truncated to at most 500 characters.
excerpt.$comment: Spring truncates the body before returning it.
